_comment: Where each environment's /api traffic goes. api_platform 'vercel': the API's Python functions in the web project itself (tools/build_api_functions.py), with each context in 'services' answered by its own function and everything else by 'all'. api_platform 'render': the single API at 'api'. frontend/vercel.json is generated from this file by tools/gen_gateway.py; never edit its rewrites or functions by hand.
